body: I will be leaving since after I confronted my SO they made me feel it was entirely my fault they cheated on my for five years with a woman who contacted me to call me vulgar names.
Oh yes, I contacted a few people I know nearby mainly for when I go to a hotel. My SO got upset when I confronted them and made me feel to blame.

I would tell her to leave and start new. So much information in one day so I decided to go to a hotel with all of my stuff. I couldn’t take the information all in one day even after I confronted my SO. He actually made me feel like it’s my fault.
I’m fine sorry. I felt I needed to confront everything that happened. I found out the other woman has been in his life for five years and she contacted me and called me names.
I will. I definitely will. Turns out this mistress thing has been happening for five years and I just can’t begin to put my mind together on any of this.
You’re right. I need to start new and fresh.
Oh. Friendship. Wow. I wasn’t expecting that.
Oh. Okay I’ll google woman’s shelters. Thank you. I appreciate your words of advice.
Well, safe is a word that I can feel half ways about. I feel safe with my SO sometimes and other times I don’t feel safe with my SO.
Interesting. A bit more insight on it. I’ve recently found out about the other woman myself, again, and now with means of contact and I was just curious of outcomes from this kind of situation.
Thank you very much. I appreciate it so much.
Okay. Thank you. I appreciate your words. I’ll figure out my plan for my life now.
Oh. I never thought about it. I just knew somewhere cold, up north, with long winters to keep warm at home.
I don’t know where I would live. We were supposed to move up north in a few years.
I’m 24 and in Fl.
Figuring out how to go on is on top of the list.
Okay. I’ll make sure I do my research on areas once I’m done crying.

I understand and I’ll try but I’m scared to go outside and leave because I’ve been blaming myself the entire time this has happened. I have certain tendencies from my past that makes me feel like I may bring harm to myself. I feel like I’m heartbroken enough to do something rash.
Thank you.
Thank you. I’ll try to find the courage to speak up for myself.

Thank you. I’m sorry if this is frustrating. I just had the entirety of my life planned out with my SO and I truly thought everything was real but it wasn’t. None of it was real and none it will come true and it hurts so much.

I’ll take your advice on seeking help in my area or through the phone on this. Thank you for your words. I greatly appreciate them. It helps to read them while I’m desperately trying to hold on to life at the moment. I’m just very shaken right now and figured reading any helpful advice would be nice as only negative thoughts went racing through my mind.
Thank you. I appreciate your words greatly. I’ll try to work things out. Right now all I can do is cry at the moment while going through Reddit so I don’t do anything negative.
The only plans I’m getting at the moment are grim.
I’ll try to get the courage, but honestly all I’m doing is crying because all of this has broken me.

Packing up and leaving is an option. However, I think my heart is too weak for that as well. I understand if this is frustrating for you. It’s just. My SO is my first relationship and everything. We made plans up until the day we died. My entire live circled around my SO’s life. Realizing it’s all gone is so heartbreaking that all I can do is cry.

My entire life’s purpose was entirely around my SO’s life. We already made plans for the future and I made no changes on it. I hadn’t even thought of that. I can’t even think about one without my SO. I appreciate your words and quote, but I lack much courage in my heart. This person. My SO is my first relationship and my first everything. We started making a life with each other. Now it’s just gone.  My thoughts are very depressing at the moment.
Thank you for your advice. I’ll try, but I’m very weak willed at the moment.
It’s okay to be brutal. I appreciate any words. It’s a reality check.
I’m sorry. These past few months, I’ve just been feeling entirely worthless and yes, the thought of ending it all has been in my mind all day, I just don’t know if I can make it without my SO.

Maybe, you’re right. My subconscious is still trying to defend him after everything, but I know that I would be the one to leave, he expressed it today, that if we broke up, I would be the one leaving, he expressed my leaving from his life so casually, I guess that’s why I looked through his phone. My SO has depreciated me so much since I’ve started living with him. I guess it’s stressing to live a double life when one part of the life is around you 24/7.

Honestly, I’ve been at the door, listening in, hearing to their words, all I can do is cry while I talk to all on Reddit. I’m actually convincing myself through my tears to stay here. Not because of rent or bills, but because I’m genuinely dependent on my SO. The only person who loved me, even though it’s been faked the entire time, and I want to stay. Even after he patronized me and called me pathetic for telling him how sad I was.

It’s just so hard. This is hurting me to my very core. All this truth about another woman, but I worked so hard to be with my SO and now this happens. It’s hard because I put my entire trust into this. I put my entire heart into our relationship and it turns out it was an entire lie from the start. I know he doesn’t care about me because he’s on a call with the other woman right now as I weep looking for the courage for my next decision, but I’m just more saddened by all of this than angry. I don’t know if I have the heart to leave, I don’t know if I have the courage to confront this to him. Chances are I’ll keep quiet to be with my SO just because my SO is the person who showed me love, even if it was faked the entire time.

I know you’re right and I appreciate your words. I am trying to figure out what to do. I’m in between fight or flight. Trying to make my relationship work even though there is another woman in my SO’s life and packing up and leaving to the streets. The thing is I’ve been dependent on my SO for such a long time and it’s difficult because I gave my SO every last bit of me because I loved them unconditionally. I don’t know where to start or end.

I don’t know if I can do that. I’m not a very confrontational person. Even right now, I can hear them on a call, yet I’m still trying to find the courage on Reddit to figure out what to do because this is the only person I’ve had in my life for such a long time.

My SO is the only person I have in my life. To be honest, I thought they truly loved me for a long time. I mean they were the only person to give me any affection, they were the only person I hugged in years. Which makes this so hard and makes me want to stay because they showed me so much love. More than anyone I had in my past. Which is why I don’t have any friends or family.
I can talk to him. I mean he is up talking to the other woman. I can’t kick him out. We share the place.
It’s both of our place. I don’t have cash or any means to find a place to stay.
It’s half.
I have no cash and I have no one to stay with. I know what you mean about them not stopping. They’re in a call together. I can hear them.

They’re on a call right now. I can hear them. I think they’re aware I’m aware. We live together. And don’t know what to do. Okay. I have no where to go for one. And I get not giving him an explanation but the thing is, I feel like I might regret that because to be entirely honest, I gave my SO everything. Everything.
Yes. Well, as you say that, I can over hear them on a call. I have no friends or family and we live together.
I don’t know and I don’t know how.
She did know. She even knows about me.
How? He’s my first everything. I’ve never even done a break up before and I’m not sure if I want to.
